_meta.disclaimer: Comparison dimensions, reliability metrics, and compromise scores are curated for demonstration of multi-attribute trade-off reasoning.

bundle_evaluations.name: Optimal Reliability & Value Bundle
bundle_evaluations.trade_off_explanation: Balances high build reliability across all 3 essentials while remaining $38.52 under the $150 budget limit. The LuminaFlex architect lamp saves desk area with its clamp, SteamGlide heats up quickly for fast morning prep, and SoundPulse ANC suppresses library/dorm chatter without exceeding budget.
bundle_evaluations.compromise_summary: Lamp requires a desk edge to clamp; steamer reservoir requires refill after 2-3 garments.

bundle_evaluations.name: Maximum Savings Bundle
bundle_evaluations.trade_off_explanation: Maximizes remaining cash with a total cost under $75.00, but sacrifices build materials, noise reduction depth, and warranty length.
bundle_evaluations.compromise_summary: Plastic gooseneck lamp with single light mode, 25dB basic ANC, and steamer with potential horizontal water sputter.

bundle_evaluations.name: Unconstrained Premium Bundle
budget_guard_flags: CRITICAL: Bundle exceeds maximum budget constraint of $150.00 by $31.99 (21.3% over budget).
ALTERNATIVE SUGGESTION: Replace buds-03 ($95.00) with buds-01 ($54.99) to bring total to $141.98 and satisfy budget guard.
bundle_evaluations.trade_off_explanation: Top-tier performance in every category, but fails the user's non-negotiable budget constraint.
bundle_evaluations.compromise_summary: Exceeds student budget. Requires explicit trade-off compromise to fit within $150.

emergency_trade_off_analysis.headline: Best Balance for Immediate Work Continuity
emergency_trade_off_analysis.trade_off_summary: ThinkPad T490 provides 16GB RAM and full Windows 11 compatibility for $289.00 with next-day guaranteed arrival ($15). Refurbished cosmetic condition is traded off for business-grade durability and keyboard reliability.

emergency_trade_off_analysis.headline: Brand New Modern Hardware at Higher Cost
emergency_trade_off_analysis.trade_off_summary: Acer Swift 3 offers brand new condition and fast 6-core CPU for $429.00, but takes 2 days for delivery and costs $140 more.

emergency_trade_off_analysis.headline: Emergency Low-Cost Temporary Solution
emergency_trade_off_analysis.trade_off_summary: Chromebook CX1 costs only $149.00 and can arrive tomorrow, but ChromeOS limits software to web applications.
